title: Everything That, Everyone Who
goal: Use todo lo que, todo aquel que and cuanto, with the indicative for real groups and the subjunctive for open ones.
grammar: todo lo que, todo aquel que and cuanto with indicative or subjunctive

items: I can say everything that and everyone who with todo lo que, todos los que and todo aquel que.
I can choose between indicative (a real group) and subjunctive (an open one).
I can use the new words for sharing and offering.
